verse.verse_2: By the Scripture that maketh plain
verse.verse_3: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
verse.verse_4: Whereon every wise command is made clear
verse.verse_5: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
verse.verse_6: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
verse.verse_7: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
verse.verse_8: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
verse.verse_9: Nay, but they play in doubt.
verse.verse_10: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
verse.verse_11: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
verse.verse_12: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
verse.verse_13: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
verse.verse_14: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
verse.verse_15: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
verse.verse_16: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
verse.verse_17: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
verse.verse_18: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
verse.verse_19: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
verse.verse_20: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
verse.verse_21: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
verse.verse_22: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
verse.verse_23: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
verse.verse_24: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
verse.verse_25: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
verse.verse_26: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
verse.verse_27: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
verse.verse_28: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
verse.verse_29: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
verse.verse_30: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
verse.verse_31: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
verse.verse_32: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
verse.verse_33: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
verse.verse_35: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
verse.verse_36: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
verse.verse_37: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
verse.verse_38: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
verse.verse_39: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
verse.verse_40: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
verse.verse_41: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
verse.verse_42: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_45: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
verse.verse_46: As the seething of boiling water.
verse.verse_47: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
verse.verse_48: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
verse.verse_49: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
verse.verse_50: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
verse.verse_51: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
verse.verse_53: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
verse.verse_54: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
verse.verse_55: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
verse.verse_56: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
verse.verse_57: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
verse.verse_58: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
verse.verse_59: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
